::: {#thm-unbiased-props}
#### Properties of unbiased estimators

If $\hparam$ is an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) estimator of $\param$, then:

$$\E{\hparam} = \param$$ {#eq-unbiased-exp}

$$\mselr{\hparam} = \var{\hparam}$$ {#eq-unbiased-mse}

:::

::: proof

@eq-unbiased-exp is the solution to @exr-unbiased-exp,
and @eq-unbiased-mse is the solution to @exr-unbiased-mse.

:::
